note.p: When comparing the employer’s name on the period of employment and the ROE, accept minor spelling differences in the employer’s name. Consider that the employer may do business under more than one name (e.g. 123456 ONT INC does business as ABC Fisheries). In this case, review the documentation on file or use the Employer search (by business number) in FTS to determine if the employer’s name on the ROE is equivalent to the employer’s name on the period of employment.
